meta.title: Drive times between nearby Colorado census tracts
meta.source: OpenStreetMap road network routed by OSRM (driving profile), tract population centre to tract population centre
meta.points_source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 Centers of Population by census tract, Colorado
meta.units: minutes, to one decimal, free-flow driving (no traffic)
meta.odbl_notice: Contains information from OpenStreetMap and OpenStreetMap Foundation, made available under the Open Database License.
limitations: Population centre to population centre: a site at the edge of a large rural tract may be some minutes nearer or farther.
Tracts with no 2020 residents use the TIGER internal point, which can sit far from a public road.
Free-flow times from the road network; no traffic, season or road closures.
Pairs farther apart than the radius in a straight line are not stored.

recheck.rule: pairs over 20 minutes and more than 6 minutes per straight-line mile, routed again from each tract's population centre and internal point; shortest kept
